title: Copper Tundra: The Sentinel's Aurora Register
premise: In a magnetized polar steppe threaded by buried power rails, the sentinel must escort witnesses through guarded crossings using a oath-bound signal shield.
ending: Recover the Aurora Register and return with the civilian refuge record; Polar Surveyors can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive conductive frost while evading the rail colossus without sacrificing the civilian refuge record.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Polar Surveyors to witness the oath-bound signal shield.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to stand guard or pursue the artifact
